title: Allah o akbar ya ali
body:
Allah o akbar ya ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali…Ali Ali (2)
<<MINI>>
Ya Ali o Ya Ali o Ya Ali (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Shah-e-Marda’n Sher-e-Yazda’n Quwat-e-Parwardigar ..(2)
Lafata Illa Ali La Saif Illa Zulfiqar
Manqabat Padta Hain Teri..(2) Rabb e Akbar Ya Ali
Ya Ali Ya Ali Allah o Akbar Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Teri Thokar Mein Fanaa Hain, Teri Thokar Mein baqaa..(2)
Murda Kar Deti Hain Zinda..(2) Teri Thokar Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Konsi Ne'mat Nahi Bete Ke Dastarkhwan Par..(2)
Khud Guzara Jow Ki Sukhi..(2) Rotiyo'n Par Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jannate Apni Banaakar Bechta Hai Sheher Mein..(2)
Yeh Hai Tere aathave(eighth)..(2) Darje Ka Nokar Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Han Do Sagi Behno Ki Tarha Fatemah Aur Zulfiqar..(2)
Baat Karti Hai Tere..(2) Bare Main Aksar Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mard Bhi Deewar Shaq Dekhe Toh Hat Jaye Magar
Aage Badhti Ja rahi Hai..(2) Teri Madar Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Dekh Kar Abbas Ko Siffin Mein Ladta Huwa..(2)
Khud Ali Kehne Lage..(2) Allah o Akbar Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Sirf Aadam Hi Nahi Har Aadmi Ka Tha Wajood..(2)
Khak Thi Jo Aap Ki..(2) Mutthi Ke Andar Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Naz'ake Alam Mein Yeh Zarra Nawazi Shukriya
Tum Takallum Ke Liye..(2) Khud Aaye Chal Kar Ya Ali
<<MINI>>
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali
Allah o Akbar Ya Ali..(4)
Ya Ali o Ya Ali o Ya Ali (2)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
